profile.tagline: I turn user problems into software, from the first question to production.
profile.subtitle: 5+ years across B2B SaaS, backend, data engineering, product leadership, and applied AI.

capabilityDescriptions.Language: Python and TypeScript are the languages I use across backend services, data pipelines, AI workflows, and web applications, including the interfaces in Football, Visualized.
capabilityDescriptions.Backend & cloud: I deliver APIs with FastAPI and Node.js, keep state in PostgreSQL and Redis, and ship containerized services with Docker. Nginx handles reverse-proxy and edge routing, and AWS is the cloud where that delivery runs.
capabilityDescriptions.Applied AI: I use LangGraph and LangSmith to build and inspect agents, the OpenAI API, Claude, and AWS Bedrock as model providers, and RAG with hybrid search to retrieve business knowledge.
capabilityDescriptions.Data engineering: I orchestrate pipelines with Apache Airflow, process data with Apache Spark, and warehouse it in Snowflake. That work covers data lakes and warehouses, plus ETL, scraping, and orchestration between operational systems and reporting.
capabilityDescriptions.Frontend: I build interfaces with Vue.js in veterinary SaaS and with React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS in Football, Visualized. The goal is to make backend and model behavior understandable to the user.
capabilityDescriptions.Product & delivery: I use system design and technical product strategy to set scope, and project and delivery management to ship it. AI-assisted engineering is part of how I implement that work, including leading five engineers at Guiavet.
